caption: The drawing depicts a single brown glass vase centrally positioned on a light beige background. The vase is tall, cylindrical, and slightly tapers towards the bottom with a rounded, outward-flaring rim at the top. The glass appears translucent, with varying shades of brown and orange, suggesting the effects of light and shadow, and a few white highlights on the upper right side reflect the light source. The base of the vase is darker brown, and there is a faint vertical white streak, representing a reflection, running from the lower part to the upper left side. The beige background is plain with a thin, lightly drawn rectangular border enclosing the vase. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "JANET RIZA" is printed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Vase
